response.overview: In the newest film by Connor Bichelmeyer, we go back in time before the ghostface killings and follow Thomas, a high school graduate preparing to head off to college. Troubled by the anxieties of higher education, Thomas seeks help from a couple close friends, who both assure him of a successful future and to enjoy the last summer. But when a random stalker steps into their lives, what was supposed to be a relaxing time has turned into the fight of their lives. Now being followed by a stranger with potentially criminal intentions, Thomas must track down the dangerous foe in order to put a stop to the madness and not enjoy the summer but survive it
response.title: Eyes on you
